nodes.description: Constant token name "Bee Finance" stored on-chain.
Constant token symbol "BEFI".
Constant number of decimals (18).
Constant total supply 2100000000 * 10**18 minted to _moveAddr in the constructor.
Private mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Private nested mapping address => address => uint256 holding allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor; requires _moveAddr != address(0) and assigns the whole totalSupply to _moveAddr.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Spends allowance allowed[_from][msg.sender] and moves _value from _from to _to using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without zero-address or race checks and emits Approval.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Loops over _users/_amounts and calls transfer for each entry; loop counter is uint8.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner and spender throughout the contract.
The uint8 loop counter i in batchTransfer wraps at 255, so when _users.length > 255 the loop never terminates and drains the caller's balance repeatedly.
Constructor parameter _moveAddr receiving the entire initial supply.
balanceOf parameter _owner used as the balances mapping key.
transfer parameter _to, recipient address (never checked against address(0)).
transfer parameter _value, amount to move.
transferFrom parameter _from, owner whose allowance and balance are spent.
transferFrom parameter _to, recipient address.
transferFrom parameter _value, amount to move.
approve parameter _spender whose allowance is set.
approve parameter _value, new allowance.
allowance parameter _owner used as the outer allowed mapping key.
allowance parameter _spender used as the inner allowed mapping key.
batchTransfer parameter _users, payee array; its length is the loop bound.
batchTransfer parameter _amounts, amounts array whose length must equal _users.length.
Local uint8 loop counter i in batchTransfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the address whose balances entry is checked and debited inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose entry is written in approve.
msg.sender balance is indirectly debited by the transfer calls executed inside batchTransfer.
totalSupply is assigned to balances[_moveAddr] in the constructor.
_moveAddr is the recipient of the initial supply and the subject of the zero-address check.
balances mapping is read in balanceOf.
_owner is the key used to read balances in balanceOf.
_to is the destination key credited in transfer.
_value is the amount subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
_from is the owner whose allowance and balance are spent in transferFrom.
_to is the destination key credited in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved in transferFrom.
balances mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
allowed mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
_spender is the inner key written in approve.
_value is the allowance written in approve.
allowed mapping is written by approve.
_owner is the outer key read in allowance.
_spender is the inner key read in allowance.
allowed mapping is read by allowance.
_users array drives the loop and its elements are the transfer recipients.
_amounts array elements are the values passed to each transfer call.
batchTransfer calls transfer once per loop iteration, executing transfer's state changes.
_users.length is compared against the uint8 counter i, enabling the counter wrap-around when the array is longer than 255.
The uint8 local i is incremented past its maximum inside the loop, causing silent wrap-around.
The overflowing uint8 counter keeps the batchTransfer loop condition true, turning it into an unbounded loop.
